messages:
sarah: Quick question — can our audit stream produce an admin-only view for tenant owners? A customer asked for a feed that excludes member-level events.
omar: Currently events have `tenant_id` + `actor.role` but we don't explicitly mark visibility. We can filter by role, but it's fuzzy (service accounts, support ops).
lee: I think we need an explicit `visibility` enum in the schema: `public|tenant_admin|system|support` — then we can expose filtered endpoints. Also helps when actors change roles later.
pat: +1. Schema change means bump version (audit_v2), and validation for customer exports. We should ensure stable fields: `event_type`, `actor_id`, `actor_role`, `visibility`, `resource`, `timestamp`, `metadata`.
maria: For hosted customers, how do we handle KMS? They want per-tenant audit encryption at rest.
kevin: For Private we can offer tenant KMS key option (bring-your-own). For hosted, envelope encrypt with a per-tenant CEK stored in our KMS; rotate keys => versioned metadata in event header.
sarah: Good. Any concerns about RBAC for reading the logs? Admin vs member? scoped tokens?
omar: Plan: add a read scope `audit:read:admin` that only returns events where `visibility=tenant_admin` or `public`. Members get `audit:read:member` which excludes admin/support/system events.
lee: Edge case — support engineers who need cross-tenant debugging. We should implement scoped session tokens with `tenant_access` claim + `elevated` flag and IRB (justification/expiration). All accesses logged with a `justification_id`.
pat: Also need API-level filters so exports for customers (S3/stream) validate that consumer identity has correct scope before delivering admin events. Add server-side validation in export job.
maria: For customers wanting to validate events, we should sign events with a per-tenant signing key (HMAC) so they can verify integrity when ingesting into SIEM.
kevin: HMAC key stored in KMS per tenant; keys rotate, include `signing_key_id` in event header. For hosted, we manage keys; for private, customer can supply.
sarah: Migration: Add `visibility` null for history initially, run backfill script to classify events. Need heuristics: `actor_role in (owner,admin)` => tenant_admin; internal system actors => system; others => member.
omar: I'll draft a small SQL for backfill and a regex to detect support accounts. Also will add unit tests for validation and schema contract.
lee: UI/Console: different audit views for Owner/Admins and Team Members. Also add an `audit-access-log` tab that shows who requested elevated read access + justification.
pat: Security review: threat model for leaks — ensure ephemeral export URLs are scoped and signed, and max TTL 1h. Pen test before release.
audit-bot: deploy-notification: schema/audit_v2 validation rules merged to staging, deployment scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC :rocket: \nkevin: Nice. Next steps: Omar to write schema PR + backfill SQL, Lee to update console mocks, Pat to run threat model, Maria to spec KMS APIs. We'll sync in 48h.
sarah: Thanks everyone. Filing RFC in docs/infra: rfc-audit-visibility.md and tagging security reviewers.
